verdict.rationale: The pack has no documentation of configuring SSO for non-gallery apps: no custom SAML setup, no custom OIDC registration, no header-based SSO, and no walkthroughs. The closest item (docs-15) covers asking Microsoft to add a SAML/OIDC app to the gallery, which is a different capability from configuring an app that sits outside the catalog. The remaining items cover application management generally, VPN-less access to internal resources, and Domain Services for legacy apps, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, apps outside the catalog still get SSO — custom SAML, OIDC, and header-based apps configured with documented walkthroughs
